name: Ei1529RC Remote Control Switch
summary: The Ei1529RC can be used in a hard-wired system to remotely test, locate (the source of an alarm) or silence, the Alarms interconnected in that system.

specs.label: Test Switch
specs.value: Allows the user to test all the interconnected Alarms at once from a convenient point rather than having to press the test button on each Alarm.

specs.label: Locate Switch
specs.value: If the Alarms are sounding, pressing the Locate Switch silences all but the originating Alarm, thus allowing easy identification of the source of the alarm.

specs.label: Silence Switch
specs.value: Allows the user to silence all interconnected Alarms at once for 10 minutes in case of false alarm.

features: The Ei1529RC is a wall mounted Remote Control device powered by 230V AC. It is recommended for use in systems comprising of three or more hardwired interconnected mains Alarms.
The Ei1529RC can perform 3 functions with a dedicated switch for each.
This remote control switch can only be interconnected via hardwire to communicate with compatible Ei Electronics Alarms and accessories. Up to 12 devices can be interconnected.
It is supplied with the necessary fixings and a surface mount box for a quick and simple installation but can also be mounted recessed into a standard back-box (not supplied).
